title: Bose Launches New Wired Earbuds
excerpt: Sales of wired earbuds are seeing a resurgence this year following several years of decline, according to recent reports.
body_html: Wired earbuds have experienced a sales increase this year following five consecutive years of decline, as wired models continue to maintain a presence in the audio market. Alongside this trend, audio brand Bose has introduced a new pair of wired earbuds that offer a straightforward listening experience.
